scenes.say: How do server components and Next.js make React apps faster and more scalable?

scenes.label: Server
scenes.sub: Server components render UI on the server, cutting client-side JavaScript.
scenes.say: Server components render parts of your UI on the server, so less JavaScript runs on the user's browser.
Next.js gives you server-side rendering, static generation, routing, and API routes—all out of the box.
Here's a simple Next.js page. It renders on the server, improving performance and search engine optimization.

scenes.question: Can server components use browser APIs?
scenes.right: No, server components can't access browser APIs or local state. Use client components for that.
scenes.say: Interviewers love to ask: Can server components use browser APIs? No—they can't. That's a key limitation.
